关键词: Office of Compliance Inspections and Examinations (OCIE)
主要内容: Norm Champ, Director of the Division of Investment Management at the SEC, delivered a speech at the 2014 IAA Investment Adviser Compliance Conference. The speech emphasized the evolving regulatory landscape for investment advisers, particularly focusing on Rule 206(4)-7, the Advisers Act compliance program rule, which has been in effect for ten years. Champ highlighted the lessons learned since its adoption and the need for continued guidance within the industry. The speech also outlined the Division's efforts to become more strategic and targeted in addressing challenges posed by budgetary constraints and new mandates under the Dodd-Frank and JOBS Acts. The focus was on improving transparency, fostering collaboration, and enhancing knowledge sharing across the Commission and with external stakeholders. Additionally, the speech discussed the reorganization of the Division to improve efficiency and communication, including the establishment of the Risk and Examinations Office (REO) to focus on industry monitoring and analysis, particularly in the investment management sector. The REO conducts financial analysis and examinations to inform regulatory initiatives and rulemaking, and collaborates with the Office of Compliance Inspections and Examinations (OCIE) on firm examinations. The speech delivered by Norm Champ, Director of the Division of Investment Management at the SEC, outlines the regulatory priorities for 2014. The focus includes continued participation in interagency working group meetings to ensure communication among agencies on market-related issues, technical challenges, and supervision approaches. The year is expected to be busy with rulemaking efforts, including the adoption of a money market fund rule, Reg. D amendments, and the removal of credit rating references in rules. The SEC is also working on improving data collection for mutual funds, closed-end funds, and ETFs, with a review of the frequency and format of portfolio holdings information. Target date funds are a priority, with plans to solicit comments on standardized risk-based glide path illustrations. The speech also highlights the importance of regulatory review and collaboration with other agencies, including the issuance of a no-action letter on the definition of 'knowledgeable employee' under the Investment Company Act.
